adrs: Reuse the React and TypeScript clarification, deterministic readiness and ConfirmedRequirementContract v2 implementation; do not duplicate semantic interpretation or contract validation in Python.

Use one typed bounded internal Node and TypeScript execution bridge behind the FastAPI modular monolith when server-side semantic validation is required; expose no independent public microservice and never interpolate user input into a shell command.

Persist original messages, questions, raw answers, interpretations, proposals, decisions and confirmed versions as distinct immutable or versioned records with PostgreSQL transactions, optimistic concurrency, payload-bound idempotency and consistent audit evidence.

Use a private local-volume evidence adapter behind an explicit storage interface for local and CI only; store bytes outside the repository and public web roots and enforce current API authorisation for every operation.

CSV and XLSX are the only evidence formats in this slice; enforce bounded size and parser resources, content and extension agreement, no macros or executable content, safe generated identifiers, traversal and symlink protection, no external fetching, and immutable SHA-256 identity.

An accepted assumption is visible business meaning, not proof of an absent field, source fact, join, credential or permission; factual data-bound generation remains ineligible until exact supported evidence bindings exist.
Supported alternatives preserve retained intent, changes, omissions, assumptions, limitations and remaining evidence needs; decline or no safe alternative cannot authorise generation.

The current authorised actor must explicitly accept the exact visible interpretation, proposal, request version, evidence and schema versions; stale, unseen, superseded, concurrent or unauthorised acceptance fails closed.

The canonical ConfirmedRequirementContract is materialised only after exact human acceptance and server-side execution of the existing deterministic prerequisites; ReportDesign remains subordinate and is not generated by APBRA-163.
APBRA-163 is local and CI only, synthetic-data only and AUD 0 cloud spend; no live Entra, Azure, paid model, customer data or hosted endpoint is authorised.

acceptance_criteria: An authorised user can resume one private case and its project-free, file-free Business or Advanced conversation after browser, API and PostgreSQL restart without losing original messages, questions, raw answers, provisional interpretations, proposals or decisions.
Original messages and raw answers remain immutable provenance distinct from AI interpretations, proposed assumptions, accepted alternatives and authoritative confirmed meaning.

An authorised user can add a supported CSV or XLSX evidence file later; protected storage, immutable digest, parser profile, observed schema and declared or inferred facts remain distinguishable and exact-versioned.

File extension, content and supported parser profile agree; unsupported, macro-enabled, malformed, oversized, traversal, symlink, external-fetch and resource-exhaustion inputs fail before eligible evidence or factual readiness is created.

Every conversation, evidence, proposal and acceptance operation re-evaluates server-derived active membership and private case or source permission; foreign-company, ungranted same-company, revoked and deactivated access fails without revealing protected existence.

A supported alternative exposes retained intent, changes, omissions, assumptions, limitations and remaining evidence needs; accept, decline and supersede are durable exact-version decisions and only acceptance can advance the proposed meaning.

The normal deterministic TypeScript clarification and confirmation prerequisites execute server-side through the bounded internal bridge; no Python semantic clone, public bridge service, shell interpolation, uncontrolled path or client assertion of validity becomes authority.

Exact authorised human acceptance binds the current request, interpretation, confirmation summary, evidence and schema versions; stale, unseen, tampered, duplicate and concurrent acceptance fails or returns the same logical result without creating divergent contracts.

ConfirmedRequirementContract v2 is persisted only after explicit exact-version acceptance, retains canonical compatibility and raw-answer provenance, and is the only authoritative business meaning consumed later; ReportDesign and generation are not started.

Description-only and insufficient-evidence cases remain useful and resumable but cannot claim factual data-bound generation readiness or invent missing fields, facts, joins, credentials or permissions.
State, immutable versions, current pointers, idempotency and required audit evidence commit consistently in PostgreSQL, with failure and restart tests preserving prior accepted history.
Four unrelated synthetic domains and renamed fields exercise the same production path without scenario, fixture, request-text, filename, KPI, table, column or visual-layout recipes.

The existing clarification budgets, semantic validators, ConfirmedRequirementContract schema compatibility, ReportDesign, compiler and candidate validation remain unchanged and their applicable regressions pass.

No report-generation operation, candidate or output history, expert assignment, optional project, public deployment, live provider call, Azure resource or paid operation is implemented or presented as complete.

escalate_when: A required registration or implementation path is outside the exact allowlists, a dependency family or architecture must change materially, or a shared schema version requires an unaccepted compatibility decision

The existing TypeScript semantic engine cannot be invoked through a bounded internal bridge without duplicating semantic authority, exposing a service, using uncontrolled paths or weakening deterministic validation
Protected CSV or XLSX processing cannot be bounded safely, requires cloud storage or malware tooling not already authorised, or exposes data outside the private local or CI profile
Implementation requires live provider credentials, Azure resources, customer data, spending, hosted exposure, external permission or another package's generation or expert capability
A required PostgreSQL, storage, browser, static, scan, hosted CI or independent exact-head review gate is missing, skipped, crashed or fails
Concurrent work changes the pinned base, branch, task authority or reviewed head, or a material security finding remains unresolved
